editorial:
Imagine gathering with your old friends for a wake, only to find out that the guy who died left behind a secret video. That is exactly how things start here. Jude was the group's camera guy, and he spent years filming everyone without them really knowing what he was capturing. The vibe starts out sad and quiet, but it quickly turns into a nightmare. As the group watches the footage, they realize Jude caught them all doing things they wanted to keep hidden. It turns a normal friendship group into a room full of people who suddenly hate and fear each other.

You will love how the tension builds up as the secrets come out. The acting feels real, and the way the movie uses the video footage makes you feel like you are right there in the room. While some parts move a bit slow at the start, the payoff is totally worth it. If you enjoy movies where people turn on each other, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best quality.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the group completely falling apart after the video reveals everyone's lies. The big twist is that Jude didn't just film them for fun; he did it to punish them from beyond the grave. As the truth comes out, the friends turn violent. By the final scene, the secrets have destroyed their lives, leaving you to realize that the camera was the real villain that exposed who they truly were.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological games and secret-filled plots.
